invariants: The private workspace retains admitted rectangular row lengths and square transform dimensions. Pivot scans choose the first minimum nonzero absolute value in row-major order; swaps and sign normalization precede elimination.

Each subtract transform has determinant one. For Bezout coefficients xa+yb=g>0, the pair matrix [[x,y],[-b/g,a/g]] has determinant one. Row operations update U; column operations update the stored columns of V. A divisibility repair adds the same row to D and U.

All internal pair helpers receive first < second from k and a later index. split_at_mut therefore yields disjoint coordinates/rows within the admitted shape. Pivot divisors are nonzero; Bezout quotients are integral.
The iterative extended-Euclid loop strictly decreases nonzero remainder magnitude, has no recursion, and normalizes the final gcd sign. It preserves old_r=old_x*a+old_y*b.
smith_normal_form_checked/smith_normal_f.iteration_policy: Count one pass only after finding a nonzero pivot. Refuse when the count equals max_pivot_iterations, before the next pass. An all-zero active block does not consume a pass.

smith_normal_form_checked/smith_normal_f.resource_boundary: Cell limits count D/U/V dense scalar slots and are not a bound on BigInt bit growth, aggregate process allocation, formatting or elapsed time. Each workspace row reservation is fallible. Scalar operations use borrowed inputs; pair updates avoid copying entire source rows.

proof_arguments: Constant TLS cells and exclusive current-thread observation prevent cross-test interference. The observer performs only infallible Cell operations and usize max selection. System receives the original allocation contracts unchanged; there is no fabricated pointer, layout rewrite, recursion-inducing observer allocation or forced allocator failure.

The RAII guard is live before invoking a measured closure and drops on both return and Rust unwind. All assertions and result disposal occur after disarming. An assertion failure is an intentional Rust test-harness failure, not an unhandled production input path.

Fixed canonical Q fixtures establish all scalar domains. Declared dimensions yield 65*65=4225 and 4096 output cells, and compiled BigRational layouts give finite representable byte thresholds. Positive controls establish that the observed allocation mechanism crosses each threshold. The negative checks therefore challenge real output-order boundaries, while making no claim about unrelated allocations, peak memory or another thread/platform.
